from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TaxesPayableRecord(BaseModel):
    """The taxes payable (应交税费) reported by one company in their financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in this financial document")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code of the company")
    taxes_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The '应交税费' ending balance amount for the reporting period")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount, e.g., '元'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Optional verbatim excerpt containing the taxes payable figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    taxes_payable_records: list[TaxesPayableRecord]
